summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the 'Rapport émargement' feature in Suivi & Émargement. All 12 test cases passed successfully. The feature correctly implements: 1) 'Rapport émargement' tab visible alongside 'Gestion des émargements' and 'Gestion des absences', 2) Formations list with Rh and Master Digital Marketing cards, 3) Students list with 3 students (Lucas Bernard, Alice Dubois, Emma Petit), 4) 'Rapport emargement' button for each student, 5) Report detail view with student name, formation info, date filters, 6) Stats dashboard with 5 cards (Taux de presence, Presences, Absences, Retards, Justifiees), 7) Attendance table with all columns (#, Date, Session, Horaires, Statut, Justification, Salle), 8) 'Telecharger le rapport PDF' button, 9) Date filters working, 10) Navigation back to students and formations lists.
